cards.mood: The piece opens with a mysterious and fluid atmosphere, establishing a sense of longing through sparse instrumentation.
cards.palette: A clean electric guitar playing arpeggiated figures with a chorus effect serves as the central melodic and harmonic driver from the Intro through the Outro.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a sparse, intimate melancholy that gradually swells into a grand, awe-struck declaration of love.
cards.vocal: A solo female vocalist delivers the performance with a soft, breathy, and ethereal timbre.
cards.palette: A grand piano serves as the harmonic backbone, playing arpeggiated chords in the intro and verses, shifting to fuller block chords in the choruses.
